import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

n = 6
k = np.arange(n)

theta = 2 * np.pi * k / n

x = np.cos(theta)
y = np.sin(theta)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))

# Einheitskreis
t = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 500)
ax.plot(np.cos(t), np.sin(t))

# Achsen
ax.axhline(0, linewidth=1)
ax.axvline(0, linewidth=1)

# Einheitswurzeln
ax.scatter(x, y)

for j in range(n):
    ax.plot([0, x[j]], [0, y[j]], linestyle="--")
    ax.text(1.12*x[j], 1.12*y[j], rf"$z_{j}$",
            ha="center", va="center")

ax.set_xlabel("Re")
ax.set_ylabel("Im")
ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 1.5)
ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

k = np.arange(3)
theta = np.pi * (1 + 6*k) / 9

r = 2

x = r * np.cos(theta)
y = r * np.sin(theta)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))

# Kreis mit Radius 2
t = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 500)
ax.plot(r*np.cos(t), r*np.sin(t))

# Achsen
ax.axhline(0, linewidth=1)
ax.axvline(0, linewidth=1)

# Lösungen
ax.scatter(x, y)

labels = [
    r"$\theta_0=\frac{\pi}{9}$",
    r"$\theta_1=\frac{7\pi}{9}$",
    r"$\theta_2=\frac{13\pi}{9}$"
]

for j in range(3):
    ax.plot([0, x[j]], [0, y[j]], linestyle="--")
    ax.text(
        1.12*x[j],
        1.12*y[j],
        labels[j],
        ha="center",
        va="center"
    )

ax.set_xlabel("Re")
ax.set_ylabel("Im")
ax.set_xlim(-2.6, 2.6)
ax.set_ylim(-2.6, 2.6)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.show()
